notes: Two-column 1883 Efimeris ton Syziteseon; nearly every crop spans both columns across the gutter (visible vertical rule mid-crop in 6, 7, 9-18, 21-40). The labels either join two half-lines (6, 7, 10, 15) or bear no relation to the crop at all (16, 17, 19, 20, 22, 29, 31, 33, 34, 36, 38 show a different, shorter text than the pixels), and several crops are multi-line slivers (1, 3, 24, 27, 28). Only a handful (2, 4, 5) are clean; with 232 lines all in the test split this book must not be used.
